LearnHarness Git backs up and syncs your LearnHarness learning data with Git: sessions, the knowledge graph, flashcards and settings. It uses the `git` on your computer with your own SSH keys or credential helper, and keeps the backup on a remote you own.

## Highlights

- **Git view:** backup status, Sync now and pending changes you can stage, diff and commit.
- **Git History:** every commit with its file count and time, expandable to the files it touched.
- **Automatic sync:** commit every N minutes, then pull and push; pull when LearnHarness starts.
- **Connect a remote:** set the URL in Settings; before the first push it flags files that may hold secrets, including in the history.
- **Second computer:** clone an existing backup into a new LearnHarness.
- **Merge conflicts:** resolved automatically (newest wins, the other version is backed up) or per file with Local / Remote and a diff. Invalid JSON is never committed.
- **Initialize repository** adds a `.gitignore` and a `.gitattributes` suited to the learning data when they are missing.

## Getting started

Requires LearnHarness 0.6.1 or newer and `git` 2.31 or newer. Download `learnharness-git-0.1.0.zip` below and extract it into the plugins folder (**Settings → Community plugins**), or build from source. Then **Refresh plugins**, turn on **Enable Git** and open **Git** in the sidebar. The README describes all three install paths.

[Documentation](https://github.com/heohlee/learnharness-git#readme)
